description: This file is a JavaScript module that defines a function to scrape recipe data from 'gimmesomeoven.com' web pages. It uses 'request' to fetch HTML content and 'cheerio' to parse and extract recipe details such as name, ingredients, instructions, time, servings, and tags.

methods.name: gimmeSomeOven
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches and parses a recipe page from 'gimmesomeoven.com', returning a Recipe object with extracted data.
